formal_trigger: A legal player attack or skill starts with nonzero windup; the player opens the system menu before that windup completes.
current_behavior: Both release coroutines await SceneTree.create_timer(windup) with process_always=true by default. GameRoot._show_system_menu pauses SceneTree but leaves _player_input_enabled unchanged; the SceneTreeTimer continues and emits the accepted attack/skill during menu pause. Other physics-driven cooldown/motion/DOT timers remain paused.
expected_behavior: Pause must not advance player gameplay windup or deal new pending-release damage behind a paused menu. On resume, an accepted action completes once without resetting cooldown or cancelling its legitimate release.
shortest_call_chain: Player.request_attack/request_skill → _emit_*_after_windup → SceneTreeTimer(default process_always=true) → GameRoot._on_player_attack/_on_player_skill → apply HP; GameRoot._show_system_menu sets tree.paused=true without changing gameplay_input_is_enabled
repair: Keep gameplay windup on one pause-aware simulation time-domain; at minimum make its SceneTreeTimer process_always=false while preserving action epoch/synchronous release and release order; do not remove lifecycle cancellation or make damage happen on menu entry.
minimum_validation: Native real GameRoot/Player with hit-guaranteed target: accept attack and skill, pause mid-windup longer than duration; assert no HP/MP release while paused; resume, exactly one release/hit, no duplicate stats, death/map transition still cancels correctly.

formal_trigger: Two distinct eligible monster footprints intersect one fast projectile's same physics segment, with far enemy having earlier stable_combat_order.
current_behavior: The projectile asks RuntimeCombatSpatialIndex.query_segment_candidates (stable combat order), loops results and applies the first exact swept hit then queue_free. It never computes earliest impact parameter along the travel segment, so far target may be damaged before nearer target.
expected_behavior: If the formal single-hit projectile policy is first physical contact, pick minimum segment-contact time t among exact hits; stable identity order may only resolve equal-time ties.
shortest_call_chain: SkillProjectile._physics_process → RuntimeCombatSpatialIndex.query_segment_candidates → _query_aabb_candidates stable_combat_order sort → first intersects → _apply_hit → queue_free
repair: Do not expand candidate set or add a second collision authority. Confirm first-impact rule; if approved, reuse same frozen segment and exact target shapes, calculate first contact parameter for eligible candidates then commit once to nearest. Preserve deterministic tie-break.
minimum_validation: Two collinear targets inside one physics step, reverse spawn/stable IDs; assert first physical contact wins and far enemy untouched; test glancing and exact-equal contacts; projectile must still be dodgeable by actual motion.

formal_trigger: A blocked player changes position solely through a zero-motion collision recovery, including without directional movement input, and a cold enemy enters their new 6/9/12 halo.
current_behavior: move_and_collide(Vector2.ZERO,false,safe_margin,true) can separate contact before position_before_move is captured. Movement event and actual_ground_motion_gu compare only after this assignment. Recovery-only displacement is not published to GameRoot._on_player_moved; event-based passive activation may await another event.
expected_behavior: Any actual externally visible player world movement crossing an activation envelope must publish one legal activation event or be covered by an existing documented position-publication event; no full per-frame monster scan.
shortest_call_chain: Player._physics_process zero-motion contact recovery → resets position_before_move → accepted_motion computed from later directional move → no movement_performed → GameRoot._on_player_moved not called → passive wake misses move
repair: First reproduce actual recovery displacement; if it occurs, publish final canonical player position change at one movement owner boundary (after all collision correction), without double-publishing or changing free 8-direction motion. Avoid new halo scans.
minimum_validation: Start overlapping valid dynamic body, no input, force recovery into halo of dormant monster; measure initial/final Ground GU and movement event count; assert target acquisition immediate and no duplicate call when directional displacement also occurs.

formal_trigger: Stealth equipment was explicitly broken by combat. While still engaged, a profile/equipment change toggles computed equipment stealth eligibility off and on.
current_behavior: _apply_profile_stats clears _stealth_break_override on any change in equipment stealth active flag, regardless of active combat. The separate equipment stealth re-arm method explicitly checks combat exit at GameRoot, so reequipping during combat can restore stealth earlier than that owner boundary.
expected_behavior: If equipment stealth is meant to stay broken until genuine combat exit, profile changes must not reset combat suppression while still engaged. Valid fresh equips outside combat must still activate stealth.
shortest_call_chain: Player.break_stealth → _stealth_break_override=true → PlayerState equipment change/profile_changed → Player._apply_profile_stats() compares _equipment_stealth_active and sets override=false → Player.is_stealthed() true while enemy remains engaged
repair: Ask main controller to verify user equipment-rearm contract. If broken-until-combat-exit is authoritative, preserve the live broken flag across stat/equipment recalculation during combat; leave normal equip/new-character/revive boundaries with existing sole owner.
minimum_validation: Attack breaks ring stealth; off/on equipment and same-stat profile change while enemy retains live target; assert no rearm until actual combat exit. Repeat unequipped-in-peace, new character and invisible summon influence.

formal_trigger: Player is stealthed and submits a cast that later fails final current world admission, e.g. wizard lightning target blocked by static LOS.
current_behavior: break_stealth is called before can_request_skill and hc_world_skill_preflight; a rejected cast attempt may still break stealth. Code has a dated explicit user-override comment: 'Any ... submission breaks stealth uniformly'.
expected_behavior: Do not change this without the exact 'submission' versus 'successfully accepted cast' product rule. Prior code comment suggests intentional stealth break even on a rejected request.
shortest_call_chain: GameRoot._try_release_skill → Player.request_skill → break_stealth → can_request_skill/_request_active_skill → GameRoot._hc_skill_preflight rejects
repair: No automatic fix. If 'submission' intentionally includes failed requests, retain; only with explicit new user ruling move stealth break to the authoritative accepted-action boundary.
minimum_validation: Decision-first deterministic stealth+blocked LOS/insufficient eligibility test; do not rewrite expected behavior based on style preferences.

formal_trigger: A formally available learned skill receives quote.valid=false for a non-MP reason (materials, invalid paired resource quotation or feature-modified definition) but mp_cost <= current_mp.
current_behavior: can_request_skill returns only MP comparison rather than quote.valid; GameRoot._try_release_skill also checks MP but not quote.valid. Player can begin animation/cooldown then canonical router _plan rejects resource quote at release.
expected_behavior: Every cast rejected by final quote should fail admission before action/cooldown start when the current production skill definitions can legally require that condition.
shortest_call_chain: Player.can_request_skill/ GameRoot._try_release_skill → ignores quote.valid → Player._request_active_skill commits timer → GameRoot._execute_canonical_skill_plan → SkillRuntimeRouter._plan rejects non-valid quote
repair: First establish a reachable real non-MP invalid quote in fixed production; if none, do not alter. If real, use quote.valid at both preflight and accepted final resource gate, preserving one canonical quote and no duplicate MP deduction.
minimum_validation: Fixed-source actual skill/extension producing invalid material or partner context; assert no cooldown, animation, stealth break or MP use when the form truly cannot cast; ordinary Taoist material-free policy remains unchanged.

formal_trigger: A successful physical hit deals final damage different from raw attack damage, or target has fewer remaining HP than incoming damage.
current_behavior: Legacy equipment lifesteal uses int(max(1,raw_damage)*life_steal_percent/100), while hit log records actual_hp_delta and Feature lifesteal handler uses damage facts actual_loss. Thus two lifesteal lanes use different bases.
expected_behavior: Needs confirmed official/current HardCore balance contract: raw attack strength, mitigated damage, or actual HP lost. Do not silently redesign healing by applying inferred preference.
shortest_call_chain: GameRoot._apply_physical_hit → WarriorCombatMath.resolve_enemy_physical_damage → CombatRuntimeService.apply_enemy_physical_damage → Enemy.hp mutation → GameRoot computes recovered from original damage; feature DamageBatch uses fact.actual_loss
repair: Retain until intended equipment lifesteal formula is confirmed by user/authoring. If same semantic basis required as feature lifesteal, change only existing post-hit calculation and verify healing cap and once-per-hit.
minimum_validation: Low-HP enemy overkill plus high physical defense plus feature lifesteal; distinguish final resolved damage and actual HP loss; preserve unchanged current balancing if intentional.
